Job Description:

The Role:

Entegris is seeking a Senior Director, Enterprise Portfolio Management Office (EPMO) to lead portfolio governance, demand management, and delivery oversight for strategic technology and digital transformation initiatives. 

This leader will partner closely with business and technology executives to ensure investments are aligned to company priorities, appropriately funded and resourced, and delivered in a predictable manner. This leader will establish the processes and governance required to move initiatives efficiently from idea through execution and value realization while driving transparency, accountability, and business outcomes across the portfolio. 

The ideal candidate combines strong portfolio and program leadership experience with the ability to influence executive decision-making, lead organizational change, and improve the effectiveness of enterprise technology investments. 

This position reports directly to the Chief Information & Digital Officer. It will be based local to one of our hubs, ideally in Chaska, MN, Bedford, MA, or Aurora, IL.

 

What You’ll Do:

Enterprise Portfolio Leadership & Governance

Lead the Enterprise Portfolio Management Office (EPMO), establishing portfolio management, governance, and delivery practices that enable successful execution of strategic initiatives.

Oversee enterprise portfolio governance, prioritization, funding, and investment decision-making to ensure alignment with business objectives and organizational capacity.

Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on portfolio strategy, investment priorities, risks, and tradeoffs.

Demand Management & Portfolio Prioritization

Own the enterprise demand management process, providing a transparent framework for evaluating, prioritizing, and approving technology and digital investments.

Lead the end-to-end portfolio lifecycle from intake and business case development through execution and value realization.

Develop portfolio metrics and reporting that provide visibility into demand, capacity, delivery performance, and investment outcomes.

Resource Planning & Portfolio Optimization

Lead enterprise-wide capacity planning and resource forecasting to balance demand, funding, and organizational readiness.

Facilitate executive decision-making regarding investment priorities, resource allocation, and portfolio tradeoffs.

Continuously evaluate portfolio performance and recommend adjustments to maximize business value and delivery effectiveness.

Strategic Program Oversight

Provide executive oversight for large-scale, cross-functional technology and business transformation initiatives.

Ensure effective risk management, governance, financial stewardship, and delivery

Executive Reporting & Value Realization

Provide executive leadership with a consolidated view of portfolio performance, investment health, risks, and realized business value.

Establish value realization measures and drive continuous improvement across portfolio management, governance, and delivery practices.

Organizational Leadership & PMO Maturity

Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing team of portfolio management professionals.

Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement while advancing portfolio management capabilities across the enterprise.

Champion organizational change management and PMO best practices to improve adoption, efficiency, and business outcomes.

What We Seek:

Demonstrated success leading an Enterprise PMO, Portfolio Management Office, or comparable function within a complex global organization.

Extensive experience managing strategic technology portfolios, enterprise transformation initiatives, and portfolio governance processes.

Strong expertise in demand management, prioritization, resource planning, investment management, and value realization.

Deep understanding of portfolio, program, project, Agile, and product delivery methodologies.

Proven ability to influence executive decision-making and build strong partnerships across business and technology functions.

Strong business and financial acumen, including business case development, budgeting, forecasting, and investment planning.

Demonstrated success leading organizational change, improving operating models, and driving measurable business outcomes.

Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Broad understanding of enterprise business processes and supporting technologies across key functional areas.

Outstanding Candidates Will Have:

Master's degree in business administration, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

10+ years of progressive leadership experience in portfolio, program, or project management.

Experience leading enterprise portfolios and large-scale digital or business transformation initiatives.

Experience transforming PMO organizations and advancing portfolio management maturity.

title: Director EUIT, Finance Product Impact, Value and Portfolio
description:
The Director, Finance Product Impact, Value and Portfolio is accountable for proving and growing the value delivered by all 17 Finance IT products across Core Finance and Finance Planning and Analytics. This role owns product health and maturity measurement, value-realisation and benefits tracking against the run-cost bridge, the product portfolio and demand pipeline, product craft standards, and the single in-house performance scorecard for AI agents and partner delivery pods. Reporting to the Executive Director, Finance IT, and leading a team of four, the Director gives the leadership team the evidence needed to decide where to invest, sustain, consolidate or retire, and to confirm that the product-and-platform operating model is delivering outcomes, not just activity. Central to the role is making the true value of IT visible and credible to the business; recognising IT not merely as a cost to be contained but as a driver of capacity, speed, quality, control and competitive advantage for the Core Functions and translating that value into hard outcomes, including a measurable productivity saving of at least 10% for each function served. The Director partners closely with the two Product Line Leads, the Senior Director Product Design and Solutions, the Director Transformation and Product Experience, senior Finance business leaders, strategic partners, Procurement, and Central Technology Risk and Data Governance to maximise value and innovation in a product-centric organisation. 

  

Key Responsibilities  

Value Realisation and Benefits Tracking: Define and run the value-measurement discipline across all 17 products, tracking benefits against the run-cost bridge ($20.0M today to the $15.0M plan of record and the $13.5M stretch aim). Report the value of agents that run IT itself and of agents that serve the business separately, never netted. Own the target of delivering a 10% productivity saving for each Core Function releasing time, effort and spend to be reinvested in higher-value work and evidence it product by product alongside the run-cost bridge, so the function sees a clear, auditable return on its IT investment.  

• Product Health and Maturity: Maintain one consistent health and maturity view of every product, covering adoption, quality, user experience, run cost and control health. Trigger intervention with the Product Line Leads where a product falls below threshold, and keep the evidence base current for leadership and gate reviews.  

• Portfolio and Demand Management: Own the portfolio and demand pipeline and keep prioritisation honest. Recommend which products to invest in, sustain, consolidate or retire, and support the phased launch of the 17 products.  

• Agent and Pod Performance Scorecard: Own the single scorecard for AI agents and partner delivery pods, covering accuracy, deflection, Service-Level Agreement and Experience-Level Agreement performance, and cost. Provide the evidence for the agent governance plane and for the two-of-four pause criterion at each phase gate.  

• Product Craft and Standards: Raise product-management craft across Product Owners and Product Analysts through standards, playbooks, coaching and a graduate pipeline, so that every product team operates to a consistent, defensible bar.  

• Team Leadership: Lead and develop a high-performing team of four, comprising two Value Measurement Leads and two Product Craft and Agent Scorecard specialists. Foster a culture of evidence, accountability and continuous improvement, and own talent development and succession planning for key roles.  

• Stakeholder and Partner Management: Manage and influence the Executive Director, Product Line Leads and senior Finance business leaders on value and portfolio decisions. Hold the embedded Outsourcing partner to account on outcome measures, working with EUIT Operational Excellence on supplier governance and with Procurement on commercial terms such as gain-share and service credits.  

• Governance, Risk and Compliance: Ensure value, benefits and scorecard reporting is auditable and evidence-based. Work with Central Technology Risk and Data Governance on AI guardrails, and ensure no agent is treated as a control until the first clean financial year-end and per-agent auditor sign-off are in place. 

• AI Adoption and Change Management: Be the thought leader for measuring the impact of AI digital workers. Feed adoption and performance evidence to the Director Transformation and Product Experience and the Senior Director Product Design and Solutions so that digital-worker leverage is directed where it creates most value. 

• Budget Management: Develop, deliver and monitor the budget, including capital, for the Product Impact, Value and Portfolio area, and track the savings run-rate against plan, flagging early where it falls below 85% of plan.  

Key Qualifications, Skills and Experience  

Key Qualifications:  

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field of study – Finance, Business, Engineering, Computer Science or Information Technology. Masters degree desirable.  

• Significant experience in a client-facing IT or product role, including strategic planning, business plan and case development, and client management.  

• Significant experience in value realisation and benefits tracking, including business models, operating models, financial models, cost-benefit analysis, budgeting and risk management.  

• Significant experience in product-centric operating models, including product portfolio and demand management, product health and maturity measurement, and product-management craft.  

• Significant experience working with diverse business ecosystems, Cloud and software-as-a-service models, and business applications. More specifically: SAP S/4HANA, BlackLine, Anaplan, Snowflake, Coupa, Concur and AWS Bedrock plus AI foundation models, large language models and measuring the performance of AI agents.  

• Significant experience in one or more Finance areas with a comprehensive understanding of business processes and drivers for success, such as record to report, purchase to pay, order to cash, and planning and forecasting.  

• Experience working with regulatory and control aspects of IT solutions in Finance, including Sarbanes-Oxley attestation and audit-ready evidence.  

• Experience having led large-scale change initiatives from planning to implementation.  

• Experience managing teams with direct and indirect reports, including work delivered through outsourced managed-service partners.  

• Experience managing outcome-based managed-service contracts, including Service-Level Agreements, Experience-Level Agreements, service credits and gain-share mechanisms.  

• Experience in co-working with cross-functional global leadership and other senior stakeholders preferred.  

• Substantial experience managing in a global matrix organisation with geographically dispersed teams.  

• Substantial experience communicating with and influencing diverse internal and external stakeholders, including supplier and vendor networks, across areas and geographies to drive value and portfolio outcomes.  

• Substantial experience anticipating, assessing and managing programme and portfolio risks.  

• Certification in product management, portfolio management or business analysis preferred.  

  

Skills & Technical Proficiency:  

• Critical/ Strategic Thinking: Influences the broader business strategy with data and insights and anticipates futuristic changes.  

• Results & Execution Focus: Sets ambitious yet realistic value targets, measures them rigorously and holds product teams and partners to outcomes.  

• Business & Sustainability: Leverages a strong understanding of the organisational structure and business financials to make strategic recommendations and advocate for sustainable business strategies.  

• Adaptability & Change Orientation: Champions bold moves and systemic changes and models resilience when faced with unexpected changes.  

• Communication, Collaboration & Influence: Is an inspiring communicator, builds strong partnerships, and bridges silos to achieve broader organisational goals.  

• Talent Development: Champions a culture based on feedforward, coaching, and stretch development and ensures a level playing field for diverse talent.  

• Business & Customer Centricity: Leverages a strong understanding of Finance functional domains, customer processes and the related IT landscape to judge where product investment creates most value.  

• Value & Insight Storytelling: Turns product, cost and performance data into clear, decision-ready evidence for the Executive Director and senior Finance leaders, and is candid when the evidence is unwelcome.  

• Product Craft & Portfolio Judgement: Applies product-management standards and portfolio thinking to prioritise, sequence and retire products, balancing value, risk and capacity.  

• AI Performance Measurement: Designs and runs measures for AI agents and partner delivery pods, and drives a culture of proactive change, skill building and application around emerging technologies and ways of working.

title: Director, Fraud Risk
description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the Role

As Director, Fraud, you will lead Airwallex’s First Line of Defence (1LoD) Fraud function. You will own the design, execution, and continuous optimization of our global fraud strategy, policies, detection systems, and operational workflows across Airwallex’s financial infrastructure. In this role, you will lead a high-performing team responsible for stopping fraud in real time while keeping friction low for legitimate, high-growth global businesses. Airwallex processes billions in cross-border payments, multi-currency corporate cards, merchant acquiring, and embedded finance products. You and your team will directly defend our ecosystem against card fraud, account takeover (ATO), merchant bust-out, payment scams, and synthetic identities.

You will partner directly with Engineering, Data Science, Product, Legal, and Compliance and interface closely with Second Line Risk to build and operate scalable, AI-native fraud detection models, effective triaging processes and operational guardrails.

What You’ll Do

  • Define & Execute 1LoD Global Fraud Strategy: Direct and build out the operational fraud strategy across all Airwallex products (Global Accounts, FX, Acquiring, Cards, and Embedded Finance / BaaS). Translate enterprise risk appetite set by the board and 2LoD Risk into actionable rules, detection logic, operational policies, and loss-prevention workflows.

  • Lead & Scale the 1LoD Fraud Team: Build, lead, and mentor a world-class team of fraud strategists, analysts, and operations specialists responsible for rule writing, alert triage, incident response, and dispute operations.

  • Optimize Risk vs. Conversion: Own and execute real-time fraud decisioning rules, loss-mitigation frameworks, and chargeback monitoring programs. Drive precision in risk controls to reduce fraud losses without introducing unnecessary friction for legitimate customers.

  • Drive Product & AI/ML Execution: Co-own the fraud product roadmap with Data Science and ML Engineering teams. Directly inform and test next-generation models for real-time transaction monitoring, device fingerprinting, behavioral biometrics, and anomaly detection.

  • Own Partner & Scheme Operational Compliance: Ensure operational adherence to fraud rules, monitoring programs, and threshold limits established by card schemes (Visa, Mastercard, local schemes), banking partners, and regulators across all active markets.

  • Incident Management & Root Cause Remediation: Lead real-time response to complex or high-value fraud incidents. Conduct post-mortems, deploy immediate policy/rule fixes, and implement long-term structural remediations.

  • Metrics & Loss Budget Ownership: Own operational KPIs, fraud loss performance against targets, False Positive Rates (FPR), triage SLAs, and chargeback recovery rates. Serve as the primary operational presenter on 1LoD performance to risk committees and leadership.

Essentials

  • 10+ years of hands-on Fraud Management experience in fintech, payment processing, acquiring, or modern banking infrastructure, with direct experience leading operational 1LoD teams and holding loss budget accountability.

  • People Leadership: Proven track record of scaling, mentoring, and directing high-performing strategy and operational fraud teams in fast-paced environments.

  • Deep Domain Expertise: Comprehensive operational knowledge of merchant acquiring fraud, card issuing fraud, CNP chargebacks, account takeover (ATO), and cross-border payment typologies.

  • Card Scheme Mastery: Deep practical expertise in Visa/Mastercard dispute management, scheme monitoring programs (e.g., VFMP, VAMP, ECM), and payment gateway risk mechanics.

  • Data & Technical Fluency: Hands-on experience working directly with complex data environments and decision engine tooling (SQL, Python/R, real-time risk platforms, rule engines).

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated ability to drive operational execution across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Legal, 2LoD Risk, and external banking partners.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Senior Accessibility Program Manager
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

At GitHub, our mission is to accelerate human progress through developer collaboration. We believe people with disabilities should benefit from that progress and directly contribute to the creation of it. 

 

We are seeking a forward-thinking, determined and innovative individual, who is passionate about the intersection of accessibility and technology, to help implement our accessibility strategy, which can be found at accessibility.github.com. This role will report directly to the Head of Accessibility and will be empowered to drive change internally and externally. 

 

 The successful candidate will:

  • Have a deep understanding of accessibility, assistive technologies, and the ways that people with disabilities interact with technology.
  • Have technical expertise that is grounded in professional experience as a software developer or designer.
  • Have hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve accessibility at scale.
  • Have professional experience managing accessibility initiatives within a large matrixed organization.
  • Have a proven track record of delivering results that empower people with disabilities to use technology. 

Responsibilities

 The goals of the GitHub accessibility program are to: 

  • Empower GitHub employees to do the best work of their lives by creating an accessible work environment with internal guides and support for procurement processes.

  • Empower developers with disabilities to build on GitHub by including their input throughout the development process, cultivating a culture of accessibility within GitHub, and driving accountability at scale.

  • Empower our customers to meet their accessibility goals when building on GitHub by aggressively dogfooding the latest GitHub platform and AI features to run our internal accessibility program, Open-sourcing our internal tools when appropriate, and sharing best practices externally.

  • Help improve the accessibility of open source by empowering people with disabilities to contribute, improving the availability and adoption of open-source Assistive Technologies, and improving the accessibility of mainstream open-source projects. 

The Senior Accessibility Program Manager may contribute to all of those program goals over time. That said, their initial focus will include, but is not limited to:

  • Manage listening systems including inclusive user research and feedback processes.
  • Build an accessibility community of practice within our Enterprise customer community.
  • Grow the capabilities of the open-source GitHub accessibility scanner and accelerate adoption by customers and open-source communities. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications :

  • 7+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area 

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications/Marketing, or related field AND 5+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area

title: Senior TPM, Mathematical Software & Algorithms
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 
ABOUT THE JOB
 
The Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software and Algorithms is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and delivery of the Battlespace Awareness software for critical programs - ensuring it meets all technical, functional, and business requirements. Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines.  This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring. 
    • Establish clear objectives and deliverables for the software that align with program needs.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Maintain a deep understanding of underlying algorithms and software interfaces for battle management, threat prediction, tracking, and classification to ensure that the relevant services integrate effectively with the larger C2 system.
    • Stay updated on the latest techniques to work with subject matter experts in incorporating relevant innovations into the project plan.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement:
    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Release Management:
    • Oversee the planning and execution of the software release process, ensuring that deployment is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
    • Ensure that all software releases meet the defined quality standards before deployment.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications, internally across teams and externally with stakeholders.
    • Regularly update stakeholders on project status, risks, and milestones through reports and presentations.
  • Resource Allocation:
    • Assess and allocate necessary resources, including personnel, software, and hardware, to ensure the project is adequately supported.
    • Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as needed to avoid bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies with the subject matter experts to minimize impact on the project timeline and deliverables.
    • Regularly review and update the risk management plan to reflect changes in the project landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work with other divisions and departments to ensure software supports the program priorities and meets all integration requirements.
    • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Battlespace Awareness business line and other stakeholders to promote a unified approach to program execution.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QAULIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.
  • Experience working on or alongside a team developing mathematical software, such as optimization solvers, estimation engines, simulation frameworks, or applied probability models.


We request transcripts as part of the early application process to understand your academic background and how your coursework supports the skills deemed critical for the role. Transcripts help us assess your technical and analytical abilities, complementing our interview process in which we also evaluate practical experience and cultural fit. If you choose not to share your transcripts, you will need to provide detailed information regarding your academic performance in relevant courses, including projects and coursework specifics, to ensure we evaluate your academic accomplishments properly. If you do provide academic transcripts, feel free to redact non-technical information (e.g., student ID, dates, non-technical coursework, etc.). Unofficial transcripts obtained online acceptable for this assessment.

US Salary Range
$167,000—$222,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines.  This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring. 
    • Establish clear objectives and deliverables for the software that align with program needs.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Maintain a deep understanding of underlying algorithms and software interfaces for battle management, threat prediction, tracking, and classification to ensure that the relevant services integrate effectively with the larger C2 system.
    • Stay updated on the latest techniques to work with subject matter experts in incorporating relevant innovations into the project plan.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement:
    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Release Management:
    • Oversee the planning and execution of the software release process, ensuring that deployment is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
    • Ensure that all software releases meet the defined quality standards before deployment.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications, internally across teams and externally with stakeholders.
    • Regularly update stakeholders on project status, risks, and milestones through reports and presentations.
  • Resource Allocation:
    • Assess and allocate necessary resources, including personnel, software, and hardware, to ensure the project is adequately supported.
    • Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as needed to avoid bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies with the subject matter experts to minimize impact on the project timeline and deliverables.
    • Regularly review and update the risk management plan to reflect changes in the project landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work with other divisions and departments to ensure software supports the program priorities and meets all integration requirements.
    • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Battlespace Awareness business line and other stakeholders to promote a unified approach to program execution.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QAULIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.
  • Experience working on or alongside a team developing mathematical software, such as optimization solvers, estimation engines, simulation frameworks, or applied probability models.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Staff Portfolio Operations Manager based in Canada.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Staff Portfolio Operations Manager to drive strategic planning, portfolio performance, and operational excellence across multiple product and technology divisions. In this role, you will initially lead Product Operations for the Hospitality business, helping senior leaders improve roadmap execution, resource allocation, and cross-functional collaboration. After an initial six-month assignment, you will transition into a permanent Business Operations position supporting Hospitality, Retail, and Financial Services portfolios. You will leverage financial insights, performance analytics, and business intelligence to guide investment decisions and identify opportunities for growth and efficiency. Working closely with senior leadership, Finance, Product, and Technology teams, you will influence strategic priorities and drive organizational improvements. This is a senior individual contributor opportunity offering significant autonomy, visibility, and the ability to shape business outcomes across a complex international technology environment.

Accountabilities:

Lead Hospitality Product Operations: Take ownership of Product Operations for the Hospitality division during the initial six-month assignment, establishing effective planning, governance, and delivery practices.

Roadmap Planning and Execution: Partner with Product and Technology leaders to develop and execute product roadmaps, manage competing priorities, coordinate dependencies, and proactively address delivery risks.

Operational Performance: Establish structured planning, reporting, and review cadences that provide leadership with clear visibility into progress, emerging challenges, and decisions requiring attention.

Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to improve operational workflows, communication, and collaboration across teams, reducing organizational silos and strengthening execution.

Portfolio Performance Management: Lead portfolio reviews across Hospitality, Retail, and Financial Services, monitoring strategic priorities, investments, delivery progress, and business outcomes.

Data-Driven Decision Making: Develop dashboards, reporting frameworks, and analytical tools to evaluate investment performance, identify performance gaps, and highlight opportunities for improvement.

Investment and Resource Optimization: Analyze business results and underlying performance drivers, recommending changes to priorities, resource allocation, and investments based on expected business value.

Cross-Portfolio Planning: Maintain visibility across product roadmaps, identifying shared dependencies, competing demands, operational risks, and opportunities for collaboration between business divisions.

Strategic Stakeholder Alignment: Work closely with senior leaders, Finance, Product Operations, and Technology teams to challenge assumptions, facilitate strategic discussions, and drive informed decisions.

Leadership Reporting: Prepare clear, actionable recommendations connecting portfolio performance and investment priorities to broader business objectives, ensuring decisions and follow-up actions are tracked through completion.

Go-to-Market Alignment: Establish consistent go-to-market handoff processes across business divisions while accommodating the specific operational needs of each portfolio.

Product and GTM Collaboration: Strengthen communication between Product and Go-to-Market teams throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring upcoming launches, feature releases, and roadmap changes are effectively communicated.

Customer and Market Insights: Develop feedback loops that bring customer needs, market intelligence, and commercial learnings back to Product teams to support roadmap decisions and prioritization.

Continuous Improvement Initiatives: Lead special projects and operational transformation initiatives that improve governance, organizational effectiveness, and overall portfolio performance.

Requirements:

Significant professional experience in SaaS product development, Product Operations, Business Operations, or a related field, with a strong understanding of product development lifecycles, roadmap planning, and execution.

Demonstrated experience managing complex programs or portfolios across multiple teams, including prioritization, resource allocation, cross-functional dependencies, risk management, and business performance.

Strong analytical and financial expertise, with practical experience developing portfolio reports, dashboards, financial models, and investment tracking frameworks.

Proven ability to interpret complex business data and translate performance insights into actionable recommendations that support strategic planning, investment decisions, and operational improvements.

Experience working with and influencing senior executives and cross-functional stakeholders, building alignment, challenging assumptions, and driving decisions without relying on formal authority.

Excellent business judgment and problem-solving abilities, with the confidence to independently identify opportunities, anticipate challenges, and lead initiatives in ambiguous environments.

Experience designing and improving operational processes, governance structures, and ways of working within complex technology or product organizations.

Strong understanding of strategic planning and the ability to balance long-term business objectives with practical operational execution.

Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex information and adapt messaging to different audiences.

Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities, with experience collaborating across Product, Technology, Finance, and commercial functions.

A collaborative and empathetic leadership style, with the ability to understand different perspectives, navigate competing priorities, and develop solutions that deliver meaningful business outcomes.

High levels of autonomy, initiative, organization, and accountability, combined with the ability to manage several strategic priorities simultaneously.

Flexibility to accommodate Eastern Time-based collaboration and business requirements. Candidates located outside the Eastern Time Zone must be willing to adjust their working hours when necessary.

Competitive total compensation: Expected total compensation ranging from CAD 190,000 to CAD 235,000 for eligible Ontario-based candidates, depending on experience, qualifications, and other relevant factors.

description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for a Chief of Staff to help drive Doit's AI Neobank expansion across products, markets and teams. This is a senior execution role for someone who can align leadership, drive operating cadence, solve cross-functional problems and turn strategy into measurable progress.

 

What You'll Own

  • Drive strategic execution across AI Neobank priorities. 

  • Build and manage operating rhythm, OKRs, leadership updates, decision tracking and accountability. 

  • Coordinate major workstreams across product, engineering, licensing, market expansion, partnerships, finance and operations. 

  • Prepare concise decision memos, board / leadership materials, execution plans and performance reviews. 

  • Identify gaps, risks and dependencies before they become serious blockers. 

  • Help leadership make sharper trade-offs on people, capital, product and market priorities. 

  • Own special projects that require senior judgement and cross-functional authority.


What We're Looking For 

  • Strong operator with experience driving strategic execution across teams. 

  • Excellent judgement, communication, prioritization and follow-through. 

  • Able to work with founders, CEOs, leadership teams and senior external stakeholders.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity with limited guidance. 

  • Can go from high-level strategy to detailed execution without losing quality. 

  • Strong writing, business analysis and problem-solving skills. 

  • Experience in startups, consulting, strategy, operations, fintech, financial services or regional expansion is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want 

  • Makes the company move faster and with more clarity. 

  • Can challenge, align and unblock teams without adding bureaucracy. 

  • Stays close to facts, numbers, owners and deadlines. 

  • Balances strategic judgement with hands-on execution. 

  • Low ego, high ownership and strong bias for action.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who want a purely advisory role. 

  • Candidates who cannot handle pressure, ambiguity or senior accountability. 

  • People who create process without improving execution. 

  • Those who avoid operational details. 

  • People who prefer status over ownership.


Location

This role is based in UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our UK office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description:
Summary
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job, and there's no telling what you could accomplish. 

The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple and help us leave the world better than we found it. 

Apple products are as alluring on the inside as they are on the outside. Inside every one of our products are some of the world's most challenging SiP designs. Imagine yourself as a select member of the team that brings these from concept to high-volume manufacturing.

Description
This pivotal and highly visible role within the DFM organization seeks a seasoned Technical Program Management (TPM) and Quality professional with experience in semiconductor packaging or electronic assembly processes. The role involves partnering with manufacturing suppliers (OSATs or CMs) and collaborating with internal cross-functional teams, including NPI Operations, Procurement, and Engineering, to optimize product design and process for manufacturability.

The successful candidate will develop and implement robust factory and quality control systems to ensure high standards for incoming and outgoing product quality. They will deliver efficient, scalable manufacturing solutions that achieve high yields, low costs, and the ability to meet critical timelines.

This role also serves as a key point of contact during factory or quality excursions, providing clear and timely communication to management, cross-functional teams, and suppliers. The candidate will proactively identify, address, and prevent critical issues while driving continuous improvement in factory operations and product quality.

Minimum Qualifications
7+ Experience in semiconductor packaging or electronic assembly processes, including SMT, underfill/mold, laser, PVD/coating, bending, testing, and other related technologies.
B.S or M.S in Mechanical Engineering, EE, Material Science or related

Preferred Qualifications
Strong understanding of product quality and reliability, with a knowledge of industry standards and best practices.
Proven problem-solving and debugging skills with a proactive approach to addressing complex technical challenges, leveraging expertise in FA techniques and commonality studies to identify root causes and implement effective corrective actions.
Data-driven decision-making, with proficiency in tools such as JMP and Tableau for analysis and visualization.
Experience collaborating with Asia-based manufacturing suppliers to ensure quality and maintain strong partnerships.
Proven ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams, promoting collaboration among diverse individuals with varying levels of expertise.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts, create comprehensive documentation, and deliver impactful presentations.
Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and deliver results in fast-paced environments.

Pay & Benefits
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $163,500 and $246,200, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.
 

SUMMARY

This role develops, launches and sustains complex CNC milling processes, independently delivering safe, capable, compliant and cost-effective solutions.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Independently owns complete multi-axis milling solutions from manufacturability review through CAD/CAM programming, post processing, machine setup, prove-out, FAI, validation, release and production.

Programs and optimizes complex 3-, 4- and 5-axis milling processes using advanced G/M code, Macro B and Siemens and/or Fanuc control language; diagnoses complete process and machine issues.

Leads CNC activities for new-product and process improvements; Delivers on schedule, quality, capacity and cost targets with minimal intervention or rework.

Provides expert hands-on troubleshooting and failure analysis for CNC mills and related automation, probing, laser tool-setting and multi-axis systems.

Develops and implements cutting-tool, holder and fixture strategies; demonstrates advanced tool/fixture design capability and collaborates effectively with designers, suppliers and equipment builders.

Drives equipment requirements, machine selection, vendor acceptance, installation, alignment and qualification; independently interfaces with vendors and contributes technical recommendations to site and customer manufacturing discussions.

Establishes and shares CAD/CAM and machining best practices, delivers meaningful cost and productivity improvements, and formally mentors lower-level technicians, programmers and operators.

Partners across Engineering, Operations and Maintenance; prioritize multiple assignments, communicates technical decisions and completes projects on time and with high quality.

Acts as a role model for Machine Operators in terms of attitude, machine asset care, troubleshooting, adherence to processes and decision making.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Associate’s degree or equivalent technical certification preferred; equivalent combination of education and experience considered.

4+ years of advanced CNC programming required, including significate experience with 5-axis milling.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS REQUIREMENTS

Subject-matter-expert-level ability to take complex 5-axis surface milled components from concept through stable production using 5-axis milling best practices.

Experience deploying processes with machine probing, parametric programming, and machine calculations.

Advanced CAD/CAM proficiency, including 3D model preparation, geometry repair, fixture modeling, and toolpath generation.

Advanced Mastercam programming and multi-axis toolpath development required.

Proficiency with Fanuc ISO G/M and/or Siemens programming languages.

Proficiency with interpreting technical drawings and GD&T.

CMM data interpretation, use of complex manual gaging.

Expert troubleshooting, mentoring, technical leadership, and cross-functional collaboration.

Working knowledge of Macro B programming preferred.

Proficiency with Fanuc Robodrill and/or DMG DMP70 machining platforms preferred.

Experience integrating CNC equipment with automation systems, robotic loading, pallet systems, and machine-to-machine communication preferred.

title: Technical project and program manager
description:
Company Overview
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

Group/Division
With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The RAPID division is the world leading provider of reticle inspection solutions for the semiconductor industry. The company provides inspection solutions to both the mask shops and the semiconductor fabs to ensure that lithography yields are consistently high thus enabling cost-effective manufacturing.

title: Strategic Real Estate, Portfolio Planning & Strategy Lead
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Position Summary
Anduril's real estate portfolio covers 10M sq ft of R&D labs, manufacturing hubs, and offices worldwide. As Portfolio Planning & Strategy Lead, you will own the planning process that decides how much space Anduril needs, of what type, where, and when.

You'll report to the Director of Strategic Real Estate. You'll turn headcount plans, program schedules, and portfolio data into forecasts of demand and supply. You'll measure how well we use what we already have, and make the case for what to do next to division leaders and the C-suite.

This is a hands-on senior role. It suits someone who builds their own models and can work from incomplete, inconsistent data. You should already use LLMs and modern data platforms (Palantir Foundry or similar) in your work. The ideal candidate combines real estate and financial judgment with a builder's instinct and a creative, tech-forward approach to problems that have no playbook.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Real Estate Planning Cycle. Run the quarterly portfolio forecast end to end:
    • Gather headcount and program plans from Finance, Corporate Operations, and the business divisions;
    • Reconcile competing plans into one view of demand by division, workforce type, and region;
    • Publish the 5–10 year outlook that portfolio decisions rest on;
    • Track plan vs. actual across forecast versions, and explain why the numbers moved.
  • Portfolio Demand & Supply Forecasting. Forecast seat, office, R&D, and production space demand against current and committed supply. Quantify the gaps by market and year. Model scenarios (growth cases, program wins and losses, M&A, relocations, divestitures) and their OpEx and CapEx impact.
  • Efficiency & Utilization Measurement. Define and track the metrics that show whether the portfolio is working: SF per head, seat ratios, utilization, cost per seat, and production space relative to output. Benchmark them against peers. Turn the findings into recommendations to consolidate, densify, restructure leases, or expand.
  • Workforce Strategy. Work with Talent, People, and division leaders to understand how Anduril grows: hiring velocity, workforce mix (engineering, production, G&A), in-office patterns, and talent markets. Translate that into location strategy, market selection, and site timing.
  • Executive Communications. Build and present the decision materials that get C-suite and division-leader decisions made: quarterly business reviews, expansion option analyses, and leadership briefings. Lead with the answer, show the math, and stand behind the numbers.
  • Build the Planning System, Not Just the Plan. Maintain and extend our planning data pipeline and models (Palantir Foundry, Python/SQL, version-controlled datasets with automated validation), so forecasts are repeatable, auditable, and refreshable in hours. Use LLM-based agents to automate data extraction, reconciliation, analysis, and presentation production, and set the standard for how the team uses them.


Qualifications and Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Data / Information Science, Urban Planning, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in strategic real estate planning, corporate portfolio strategy, FP&A, capacity or workforce planning, real estate investing (equity or credit), development, or corporate development, including experience leading or mentoring analysts/associates.
  • Strong financial and analytical modeling. You build your own models in Excel and Python or SQL, and can defend every number in them.
  • Hands-on use of LLMs and modern data platforms (Palantir Foundry or similar, such as Databricks, Snowflake, or dbt) in your current work.
  • Excellent communication, with a demonstrated capacity to influence cross-functional teams and senior executives.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% for site visits, stakeholder meetings, and industry events.
  • U.S. citizenship required; eligibility for security clearance preferred.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience forecasting space for manufacturing, R&D, or other capital-intensive operations, not only office.
  • A track record of building forecasts from incomplete or conflicting plan data, and explaining to leadership why they changed.
  • Experience planning around M&A integration, relocations, or consolidations.
  • Background in defense, aerospace, or another fast-growing hardware company.

Job Summary

The Connected Worker Program Manager will serve as the strategic leader for the Connected Workforce initiative within the Varian Business Unit. This role will drive the vision, roadmap, governance, deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement of Connected Workforce solutions across the enterprise. The program manager will partner with business leaders, Automation Technology Group (ATG), IT, and external partners to accelerate digital transformation, improve operational performance, standardize business processes, and maximize return on technology investments.

Own the Connected Workforce portfolio, roadmap, governance framework, and prioritization process.

Lead medium-to-large scale programs, ensuring alignment to scope, schedule, budget, risks, and strategic objectives.

Coordinate development and deployment activities with ATG, IT, vendors, and business stakeholders.

Develop executive communications, portfolio reviews, KPI dashboards, and value realization reporting.

Lead organizational change management efforts, including stakeholder engagement, communication planning, and adoption strategies.

Manage software licensing, hardware planning, vendor engagement, and solution governance.

Deep understanding of digital transformation, Connected Workforce platforms, and enterprise technology adoption.

Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to balance competing priorities and organizational objectives.

Knowledge of change management principles and technology adoption best practices.

About the Role

We are seeking a Level 4 Facilities & Real Estate Technical Project Manager to lead delivery of mission-critical infrastructure projects that enable semiconductor R&D and advanced manufacturing operations.

This role is accountable for cleanroom retrofit/build projects and tool-ready infrastructure/process utilities (highest priorities), managing work from feasibility through commissioning and turnover in a live, operational environment.

This is a senior individual contributor role (no direct reports) that operates in a matrix environment with strong support from controls, electrical, IT, gas/life safety, EHS, and administrative resources.

The TPM will own scope, schedule, and CAPEX forecasting, and will lead cross-functional alignment with lab owners, R&D/Engineering, Operations, and Logistics.

Note: This role does not coordinate tool installs directly; it is responsible for delivering infrastructure readiness to support tool installation and ongoing operations.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Project Leadership (End-to-End Delivery)

Lead facilities and real estate capital projects from concept/feasibility through design, construction, commissioning, and closeout.

Develop and manage project execution plans including phasing strategies, shutdown/tie-in plans, and business continuity measures for live operations.

Drive disciplined scope definition and establish clear design and construction deliverables, acceptance criteria, and turnover requirements.

Top Priority #1: Tool-Ready Infrastructure / Process Utilities

Deliver infrastructure upgrades and expansions supporting semiconductor tools and R&D operations, including coordination of HVAC and environmental control systems; process and general exhaust systems; make-up air and airflow balance strategies; clean dry air (CDA), vacuum, and other process utilities (as applicable); electrical distribution; controls/BMS integration; and monitoring systems.

Coordinate specialty gas infrastructure interfaces in partnership with gas/life safety SMEs.

Ensure infrastructure designs and field execution align with operational needs, reliability targets, and safety requirements.

Top Priority #2: Cleanroom Retrofit / Build

Lead cleanroom retrofit/build efforts while protecting contamination control, safety, and uptime.

Coordinate cleanroom design and execution considerations including ISO classification considerations, pressure regimes, airflow patterns, filtration strategies, and contamination control practices during construction.

Plan commissioning readiness and operational turnover.

Construction & Contractor Management

Lead RFP development, bid evaluation, contractor selection recommendations, and ongoing contract administration in partnership with Procurement.

Manage construction execution including RFIs, submittals, field coordination, quality inspections, safety compliance, change management, schedule recovery plans, and punch list closure.

Coordinate commissioning activities, turnover documentation, and closeout packages.

Financial & Schedule Ownership (L4 Expectations)

Own project financial management with emphasis on CAPEX forecasting, monthly projections, accrual coordination, and variance analysis (PO approval monitoring).

Evaluate change orders and manage forecast impacts (cost and schedule).

Build and maintain integrated schedules in Microsoft Project (required) including logic ties, milestones, critical path management, and progress updates.

Partner with controls support for reporting and schedule performance insights; Primavera P6 exposure is a plus for future scaling.

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Leadership (Matrix Execution)

Serve as the primary project integrator across Facilities, EHS, Security, IT, Engineering, R&D, Operations, and Logistics.

Lead effective meetings (weekly project reviews, design reviews, construction coordination, commissioning readiness).

Communicate clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders; escalate risks early with recommended mitigation paths.

Influence without authority while maintaining accountability across internal partners and contractors.

What Success Looks Like (Performance Outcomes)

Infrastructure readiness delivered on time to support tool enablement and lab operations (tool install managed by others).

Cleanroom retrofit/build projects executed with strong contamination control, safety performance, and minimal operational disruption.

Forecast accuracy improves over the project lifecycle with transparent variance explanations and proactive corrective actions.

Contractors managed effectively: quality execution, controlled change, safe work, and predictable turnover.

Stakeholders describe execution as disciplined, transparent, and operationally sensitive.

Required Qualifications

5–10 years of progressive project management experience in facilities capital projects; 10–15 years preferred for complex, independent ownership.

Demonstrated delivery of MEP-intensive projects in operational environments (manufacturing, life sciences, data centers, advanced R&D, or similar).

Proven ability to lead construction administration including RFIs, submittals, contractor performance management, and change control.

Strong competency in CAPEX forecasting, cost tracking, and variance reporting (PO approval not required).

Microsoft Project proficiency (required): ability to build schedules from scratch and manage critical path and updates.

Strong communication and stakeholder leadership in a matrixed environment.

Highly Desirable Qualifications

Experience delivering tool-ready infrastructure for semiconductor or advanced manufacturing environments.

Experience with cleanrooms (retrofit/build, contamination control practices, operational turnover).

Primavera P6 exposure (nice-to-have) for potential future adoption.

PMP (or equivalent) is a plus.

Familiarity with commissioning approaches for MEP/process utility systems and structured turnover documentation.

Core Competencies (Level 4)

Technical breadth: understands how building systems interact; can challenge assumptions and spot coordination gaps.

Owner-rep rigor: clear scope control, disciplined change management, contract/commercial awareness.

Operational sensitivity: plans work to protect uptime, safety, and contamination control.

Predictive management: anticipates risk and communicates mitigation early; drives decision-making.

Stakeholder leadership: influences without authority, aligns competing priorities, and maintains accountability.

Working Conditions

Onsite presence required; work includes frequent field walks and active construction areas.

Occasional off-hours coordination may be required for shutdowns/tie-ins and critical work windows.

We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. title: Senior TPM, Mathematical Software & Algorithms
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 
ABOUT THE JOB
 
The Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software and Algorithms is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and delivery of the Battlespace Awareness software for critical programs - ensuring it meets all technical, functional, and business requirements. Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines.  This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring. 
    • Establish clear objectives and deliverables for the software that align with program needs.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Maintain a deep understanding of underlying algorithms and software interfaces for battle management, threat prediction, tracking, and classification to ensure that the relevant services integrate effectively with the larger C2 system.
    • Stay updated on the latest techniques to work with subject matter experts in incorporating relevant innovations into the project plan.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement:
    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Release Management:
    • Oversee the planning and execution of the software release process, ensuring that deployment is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
    • Ensure that all software releases meet the defined quality standards before deployment.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications, internally across teams and externally with stakeholders.
    • Regularly update stakeholders on project status, risks, and milestones through reports and presentations.
  • Resource Allocation:
    • Assess and allocate necessary resources, including personnel, software, and hardware, to ensure the project is adequately supported.
    • Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as needed to avoid bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies with the subject matter experts to minimize impact on the project timeline and deliverables.
    • Regularly review and update the risk management plan to reflect changes in the project landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work with other divisions and departments to ensure software supports the program priorities and meets all integration requirements.
    • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Battlespace Awareness business line and other stakeholders to promote a unified approach to program execution.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QAULIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.
  • Experience working on or alongside a team developing mathematical software, such as optimization solvers, estimation engines, simulation frameworks, or applied probability models.

You will keep the technical performance and delivery schedules of these products aligned across BNS platforms and other Blue Origin business units, so every item is delivered when it is needed and performs its function.
